title: Rhythm Games
tagline: Feel the beat. Hit the timing.
shortDescription: Players hit the cues in time with the music, on a touch surface, buttons, or real products built into the installation. A fast, replayable challenge that rewards focus and gets people competing for the top score.
longDescription: A timing challenge built around cues that arrive with the beat of a track. Players tap, press, or step at the right moment, and every hit is scored for timing, with bonus points for streaks. Inputs can be a touch surface, buzzers, foot pedals, custom controls, or physical products placed in the setup, so a row of knives on a counter or a set of objects on a shelf becomes the instrument. The music, cue patterns, difficulty, round length, and visuals are configurable, and a round can end with a prize or a place on the leaderboard. BRDGE handles the interaction logic, scene management, and journey, leaderboard, and data links end to end.

highlights.title: The Product Becomes the Instrument
highlights.description: Real products placed in the setup can act as the hit zones, so players touch and look closely at the product while they play, instead of only watching a screen.

highlights.title: Easy to Start, Hard to Master
highlights.description: Anyone understands "hit it on the beat" within seconds, while scoring and difficulty levels keep good players coming back for one more round.

highlights.title: A Show for the Bystanders
highlights.description: Music, light, and fast hands draw a crowd around the player, turning a quiet corner of a shop or stand into a lively spot.

highlights.title: Remix the Challenge
highlights.description: Add a two-player battle, a crowd mode where several people play one track together, a custom track built from the brand's jingle, or a VR version played with headset and controllers.

highlights.title: Any Beat, Any Brand
highlights.description: Run a knife-skills challenge in a brand store, a drum session at a music festival, a jingle game for a product launch, or a festive edition with seasonal tracks.

highlights.title: Score the Engagement
highlights.description: Add a data layer that records rounds played, scores, accuracy, and replays, plus optional contact details for a prize, giving the client clear numbers on reach and participation.

highlights.title: Turn Up the Volume
highlights.description: Pair with Prize Draw to reward the best players, with Visitor Identificator to keep each player's best score, or with Live Feed to show the leaderboard on screens across the venue.
